_meta.purpose: Boss → wakeup-class classification. Tracks chrs whose AI starts in a dormant pose (kneeling, sitting, curled, half-buried) and requires an external wake-handshake to transition to active combat. Distinct from entrance_animations.json (which gates emerge-from-ground geometry) and scripted_intro_chrs.json (which gates NB-anchor cinematic dependencies). Wakeup chrs fail by sitting indefinitely in their dormant pose at slots whose EMEVD doesn't fire a recognized wake handshake.

values.wakeup_dormant: Chr starts in a dormant pose and AI does not tick to combat without an external wake trigger. Vanilla slots fire this trigger via encounter EMEVD that calls EnableCharacterAI + a proximity/damage wake condition. Non-vanilla slots may lack the call entirely (chr spawns dormant and never wakes) or may use a wake handler whose Combat-only gate doesn't pass for chrs that idle in Recognition/Alert states. Runtime mitigations: permissive_boss_wake (wake handshakes, emevd_patch.py:131) and permissive_spawn_emerge (spawn-and-anim handlers, emevd_patch.py:172). Coverage gap: slots whose spawn scripts dispatch through events NOT in those allowlists.
values.unknown: Not yet classified. Default. No gate applied — chr placement proceeds as normal.

_meta.provenance: Manual seed from empirical reports + historical exclude-set archaeology. Five confirmed chrs: c4660 Guardian Golem (Cathedral instances; user report v0.24.86), c5790 (Guardian Golem variant, behbnd template-mate of c4660 with identical hp/hitHeight in vanilla NpcParam), c4603 Stonedigger Troll (Cave/Tunnel mid-boss; user report v0.24.86), c4470 Abductor Virgin (historical exclude per oops_v3.py:455 comment, removed after permissive_boss_wake landed), c5110 Maris Tendril (same exclude history, same comment).
_meta.relationship_to_other_classifications: Wakeup is INDEPENDENT of entrance_animations and scripted_intro_chrs. A chr may be classified in multiple files (e.g. c4470 is emerge_from_ground in entrance_animations.json AND wakeup_dormant here — different failure modes, different gates). Cross-classification is expected and load-time merge is additive: chr is gated by EACH applicable class's slot blacklist.
_meta.structural_caveat_per_instance_vs_per_ch: Wakeup is partly a per-MSB-INSTANCE property, not purely per-chr. Vanilla ER positions Guardian Golems (c4660) in dormant pose at Cathedral instances and active stance at Fort Faroth instances — same chr-id, different initial states authored at the MSB level. The rando shuffles chr-ids into slots; the slot's EMEVD determines whether to spawn dormant or active. If a wakeup chr is placed at a slot whose EMEVD doesn't impose dormant pose, the chr just spawns awake and aggros normally — no failure. The failure mode is the OPPOSITE: a wakeup chr placed at a slot that DOES impose dormant pose, then fails to fire a recognized wake handshake. The classification here marks chrs that HAVE a dormant default state (so the gate is conservative — may block placements that would have worked fine because the slot didn't dormant-pose them). Empirically, this conservative false-positive rate is acceptable per the same logic v0.24.83 used for emerge false positives in template c880d10143.
_meta.methodology_limit: Unlike emerge_from_ground (template c880d10143, 25-chr cluster from a single seed via v0.24.82 behbnd hashing), wakeup chrs sit in small bespoke behbnd templates: c4660 in template 8580403044 (cluster size 2 with c5790), c4603 in singleton template b76a295e80, c4382 Stonedigger variant in singleton template dddff5f491. Template clustering provides minimal expansion leverage — each wakeup chr is essentially its own AI authoring. Growth path for this list is empirical playtest reports and historical-exclude archaeology, NOT template expansion.

_meta.engine_integration_proposal: v0.24.86 empirical audit (above) concluded the slot-side file nr_no_wake_slots.json is not needed: 100% of vanilla wakeup-chr placements are covered by existing patches. The chr-level V3_WAKEUP_CLASS hook is still useful for future per-chr engine logic if a non-covered case surfaces, but the gate-on-slot mechanism sketched in earlier revisions is not warranted at this time.
_meta.growth_pattern: Add chrs as new freeze-dormant reports surface OR as historical-exclude archaeology surfaces previously-excluded chrs whose exclusion was lifted by EMEVD patches. Conservative — when in doubt, leave as 'unknown'.

empirical_audit_v0_24_86.method: Full vanilla NR audit using nr_decompiled_msbs (300 MSBs) + vanilla_decompressed_emevd (194 per-map EMEVD files). For every Part in every MSB whose model is a wakeup-class chr (c4470, c4603, c4660, c5110, c5790), look up the Part's own_entity_id and check whether that entity is referenced by any allowlisted (8) or cinematic-excluded (4) common_func wake-handshake event.
empirical_audit_v0_24_86.interpretation: v0.24.86 permissive_boss_wake covers 100% of chr wake-handshake dispatches that exist. Most wakeup-chr placements (97/103) do NOT use a scripted wake handshake at all — they spawn via AI proximity-aggro (already enabled by permissive_spawn_emerge on the 90085XXX/90035XXX spawn handlers) or as death-linked minions of multi-entity boss orchestrators (90075351/352) that call EnableCharacterAI explicitly. The 6 covered placements are the m46_60 Nightlord arena Guardian Golems via paired 90015000+90015030, fully patched.
empirical_audit_v0_24_86.legacy_dungeon_midboss_fingerprint: All audited mid-boss chrs (c4660, c4470, c4600 in m30/m32 sample) share an identical 15-dispatch EMEVD fingerprint: 2x 90015007 (allowlisted) + 2x 90015031 (allowlisted) for wake; 1x 90015002 (cinematic-excluded) supplementary for HP-bar/BGM timing; 3x 90035280 + 1x 90035281 for time-of-day spawn scheduling (network event flags only, no chr ops); 1x 90085700 for mission progress. The wake critical path goes through the allowlisted events; the cinematic 90015002 doesn't gate the chr's AI activation.
empirical_audit_v0_24_86.no_slot_blacklist_needed: nr_no_wake_slots.json is NOT needed. There is no slot subset whose wakeup-chr placement fails under v0.24.86. The chr-level wakeup_chrs.json classification stands as documentation and as a hook for any future per-chr engine logic, but no slot-side gate is warranted by vanilla data. If empirical CTD/freeze reports surface later, they can grow nr_no_wake_slots.json organically from those reports — same growth pattern as nr_no_emerge_slots.json.
false_alarms_during_audit: 11 entities under '<map_prefix>5300' across m30/m32/m34/m38 routed ONLY through 90015301: NOT chr targets. Resolved as c0100 player-spawn group IDs used by 90015301 to track player combat state. Event correctly excluded from patch on different grounds than originally documented (player-state tracker, not cinematic encounter).
c4660 has 3 placements in m46_05_00_00 with entity_id=0: shell MSB (1352-char EMEVD with zero spawn calls). Dev placeholder, not live vanilla content.
